rationale: The record examines the political sociology and geo-economics of nanotechnology research agendas in the United States, Mexico, Brazil and Argentina. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4; E01 wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both the narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 result in exclusion because the study is entirely off-topic (nanotechnology R&D political economy) and does not address water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Sociología política de la nanotecnología en el hemisferio occidental: el caso de Estados Unidos, México, Brasil y Argentina
This paper addresses nanotechnology from a socio- political and geo-economic perspective in order to highlight the dynamics and interests at stake
